verdict.rationale: Oyster is an HR and employment platform. A buyer could fairly ask whether it lets users configure background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows built-in, marketing-level 'automations' (automated expenses, time-off, reports) and API webhooks or endpoints that a developer could use to build automations. Neither is a documented, user-configurable feature for setting up autonomous background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
